steps.en: Add the OOXML artifact to the JVM build
steps.zh: 把 OOXML 构件加入 JVM 构建

steps.en: Puts the Workbook API on the classpath, with xmlbeans and commons-*
steps.zh: 把表格 API 和 xmlbeans 放进 classpath

steps.en: Open an existing workbook or start a new XSSF one
steps.zh: 打开已有工作簿，或新建一份 XSSF

steps.en: Detects OLE2 vs OOXML and builds HSSFWorkbook or XSSFWorkbook
steps.zh: 识别 OLE2 或 OOXML，建成对应 Workbook

steps.en: Create or edit sheets, rows, and cells, then write the file
steps.zh: 创建或改工作表、行和单元格，再写出文件

steps.en: Serializes the package as .xls (OLE2) or .xlsx (ZIP+XML) bytes

value.en: The JVM writes a real Excel file without Microsoft Office installed
value.zh: JVM 在未安装 Microsoft Office 的情况下写出一份真的 Excel 文件

sources: https://github.com/apache/poi README.md (Getting started; Jars: poi-ooxml; Requires Java 11 or later on trunk)
https://poi.apache.org/components/index.html (Component Map: Maven artifactId poi-ooxml; WorkbookFactory requires poi-ooxml)
https://poi.apache.org/components/spreadsheet/quick-guide.html (New Workbook: new XSSFWorkbook(); Files vs InputStreams / Reading and Rewriting: WorkbookFactory.create; wb.write(fileOut))
